data.gender_notes: Aaila is used as a unisex name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Arabic ʿāʾila (عائلة) 'family, household', from the root ʿ-w-l. Used as a female given name in Muslim communities. Aaila therefore means “Family; household; kin”. Arabic noun ʿāʾila 'family, household'; used as a female given name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaila expresses “Mountain of Allah”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From Arabic ʿāʾila (عائلة) 'family, household', from the root ʿ-w-l. Used as a female given name in Muslim communities.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaila total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
